svg.title: Ruinous — bladed rose sigil (mono)
svg.desc: Single-colour sigil: every fill is currentColor. Blade facets are carried by opacity; the rose is three concentric rings of outward-pointing blade-petals (outer ~0.58, middle 0.8, solid inner cup; each petal bevelled by a darker shadow-side facet) separated by clean gaps, with a hollow centre. Inline it and set the CSS color of its container; as an img it renders in the default black.
